lessons.claim: A rejection threshold that a reference case sits exactly on will reject the reference case. GSER masks frequencies where alpha is outside [0,1] as unphysical, but a purely viscous fluid has alpha = 1 EXACTLY, and np.polyfit returns 1.0000000000000002 for about half the points of an exact power law. With a strict <= the Newtonian validation case masked out 116 of 240 points and failed the test written to confirm it. Fixed with ALPHA_TOL = 1e-9. Same reason checks.CMP_RTOL exists. Measured 2026-09-02.
